title: Recording: I Lie Around by Wings; Long Haired Lady by Paul and Linda McCartney | 1971
content:
Studio A-1, A&R Recording, New York City
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Dixon Van Winkle

Paul McCartney worked on two songs on 4 February 1971: ‘I Lie Around’ and ‘Long Haired Lady’.

‘I Lie Around’ received an autoharp overdub. The song was completed in November 1972 after the formation of Wings. It was released in June 1973 as the b-side of the ‘Live And Let Die’ single.

‘Long Haired Lady’ was recorded for the Ram album. On this day it was given acoustic guitar and bass guitar overdubs.
